verses.pali: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, someone with four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti—
verses.english: They kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, and lie.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ nirayeti.
verses.english: Someone with these four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
astute people don’t praise these things.”
